HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

Qualifications

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。

每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。

  • 弹性福利

当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，My Choice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。

  • 心理健康咨询

您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。

  • 企业年金

汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。

  • 弹性工作

为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。

  • PSQP专业进修计划

专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

Job Description

About the Team

The China AI Platform team will operate with the speed and spirit of a startup, focused on rapidly prototyping and building cutting-edge AI use cases that directly address the critical needs of our businesses in China. The primary goal of this team is to establish the AI platform foundation, demonstrate the transformative potential of AI within the firm, rapidly deliver impactful solutions, and then seamlessly transfer the code, knowledge, and ownership to the respective business and engineering teams. This hands-on engineering role is pivotal in shaping the future of AI adoption at Goldman Sachs China and fostering a culture of innovation and accelerated development.

About The Role

As an AI Platform Specialist, you will be instrumental in identifying, developing, and deploying end-to-end AI/Machine Learning solutions that drive tangible business value; you will work in a fast-paced environment, leveraging your expertise to translate complex business challenges and customer needs into actionable AI architectures and technical specifications, and then implement and deliver these systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Platform Foundation: Lead the engagement with vendors for the establishment of the foundational AI platform to support the rapidly growing demand of AI use cases across China business units.
  • Rapid Prototyping & End-to-End Development: Lead the end-to-end development of AI/ML models and applications, from ideation and data exploration to rapid prototyping and initial deployment.
  • Business Partnership & Solution Architecture: Collaborate closely with business and engineering teams to deeply understand their challenges and customer needs, identify high-impact AI use cases, and translate business requirements into robust technical specifications and solution architectures.
  • Solution Implementation & Delivery: Architect, implement, and deliver scalable, robust, and maintainable AI solutions based on defined technical specifications and architectures, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and workflows within the Goldman Sachs ecosystem.
  • Knowledge Transfer & Enablement: Facilitate effective knowledge transfer through comprehensive documentation, training sessions, mentorship, and pair-programming, empowering receiving teams to take ownership and continue the development of AI solutions.
  • Technology & Innovation Leadership: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in AI, machine learning, and relevant technologies, continuously evaluating and recommending new tools, techniques, and best practices to drive innovation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
  • Hands-on experience in AI/ML area, with a proven track record of delivering AI solutions in a professional setting.
  • Hands-on experience across the GenAI application stack: from single-agent orchestration (LangChain) and multi-agent collaboration (AgentScope) to low-code platforms (Dify) and enterprise managed services (Amazon Bedrock, Alibaba Model Studio).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, along with relevant AI/ML frameworks.
  • Excellent communication capabilities, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Alibaba)
  • Experience with Data Platform and the integration with AI Platform
  • Deep understanding of SDLC and developer efficiency solutions

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veterans status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

该职位来源于猎聘 The Centralized Research Group (CRG) is part of CIB R&A covering Banking globally. It works closely with the firm’s Investment Banking (IB), Commercial Banking (CB) and Global Corporate Banking (GCB) teams offering customized financial solutions across Mergers & Acquisitions, Equity / Debt capital raising, Credit, Treasury, Cash Management, Trade, and Markets, among others.
Functional Responsibilities: The main responsibilities will include: Industry or Product coverage: Build deep expertise and insight on industry, impact of economic / market conditions, competitive landscape, risks, trends, etc. that can be leveraged by bankers for maintaining and initiating new client relationships and generate high quality reports suggesting possible courses of action. Cover sector(s) and track developments regularly. Summarize and synthesize news updates / research reports on priority clients, regular industry reports. Work with bankers to understand clients’ needs and provide appropriate product solutions Identifying opportunities: Track a select list of priority clients and work together with the senior bankers to evaluate potential deal opportunities across the entire range of solutions and services offered Pitching material preparation: Work with bankers to prepare marketing materials for clients including components like market and industry landscapes, treasury relationship reviews / client health checks, opportunity memos, financial analysis & benchmarking, target companies’ / investors’ profiles, market information, etc. Produce client-ready output which is crisp and relevant and is accompanied with well-structured presentations Research & Financial analysis: Analysis and interpretation of financial statements including preparing comparables, modeling & valuations, working capital analysis, benchmarking, etc. Work on extensive valuations without any guidance and be comfortable with valuation techniques. Understand transaction structures and be able to determine applicability to the clients. Calculate and draw insights from a set of financial measures / models Project Management: Comprehend projects with a high level of accuracy & display a strong end-to-end understanding of the deliverables. Engage proactively with bankers to understand client perspective and make new suggestions regarding analysis, slides or provide a new perspective. Work with senior management on various CRG-wide initiatives like hiring, training, knowledge development, etc. Automation / Efficiency Initiatives: Identify automation opportunities to eliminate manual and recurring tasks, simplify complicated tasks and increase overall efficiency. Use basic knowledge of coding to come up and communicate ideas on transforming a business process digitally Communication: Maintain regular value-added contact with bankers and staffers in the appropriate geography both proactively and in response to specific requests with a clear distinction between fact, informed opinion and uninformed opinion (hunch). Engage and communicate effectively with managers to keep them informed of activity in the region Team Management: Review priorities & manage team expectations proactively; manage and monitor workload to ensure that all internal/external deadlines are met; become a mentor for the juniors in the team and help them develop the right skill sets by reviewing their work; provide clear guidance to the team to maximize efficiency
Compliance: Ensure the highest international ethical standards and regulatory compliance within the team
Essential Skills / Qualifications: At least 4 years of work experience from top Tier school / or professional qualification in Accountancy / Finance Self-starter with excellent academic record; self-motivated, quick learner, comfortable with responsibility Strong financial and analytical skill set; strong knowledge of corporate valuation & modelling Good awareness of Investment Banking / Commercial Banking / Corporate Banking solutions and services is a plus Good communication skills, adaptable to effectively partner with various stakeholders across the globe, strong at building relationships across teams Proactive with strong attention to detail and ability to deliver output of a very high standard Excellent organization, planning and time management skills - Able to multi task, deliver results and meet deadlines under pressure Strong written and presentation skills with expert handling of excel & powerpoint Good team player with an analytical bent of mind People management experiences is required

Job Summary

The Product Owner (PO) is a sole person (not a committee), who is responsible for owning the end-to-end customer journeys and product vision & lifecycle. They have a delegated authority and empowerment to prioritize the product backlog to maximize the value of our products or services for both our customers and our business. Their core ethos is to make informed decisions to ensure each investment decision results in the maximum outcome (as measured by OKRs) balancing both short-medium- and long-term horizons.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cooperate with China wealth team to promote the wealth solution to SME clients, including but not limited to structure notes, mutual funds, and foreign exchange.
  • Leverage on client and market insights to design and lead the develop of the differentiated client journey for defined SME persona
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a clear product vision and roadmap that aligns with the Hive’s and Bank’s objectives.
  • Own and prioritize the squad’s backlog, ensuring user stories are well-defined, refined and aligned to product roadmap, achieving Hive/Domain’s strategic outcome and scorecard priorities
  • Align business stakeholders and technology partners to ensure a clear common objective.
  • Ensure both Hive and Squad understand the why, the purpose and the mission.
  • Lead the squad to deliver relevant and impactful features balancing quality and speed.
  • Be an active participant in Agile ceremonies and foster a culture of continuous improvement together.
  • Own the overall product quality and outcomes by adoption key agile processes (e.g. DOR & DOD)
  • Have awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  • Proactively and courageously identify, analyse, and steer solutions on organizational impediments and constraints to productivity, quality, early risk mitigation, and continuous delivery of value.
  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • May act as a Chapter Lead, spearheading initiatives to elevate the skills and impact of Product Owner throughout the Hive

Product Leadership, Engagement & Strategy

  • Champion the voice of the customer
  • Build and maintain close rapport with key stakeholders i.e. Hive Lead, Domain Tech Lead, Engineering Lead, Solution Architects, UI/UX Designers, Business stakeholders to influence outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Hive Lead and Solution Architect, to craft a clear and easy-to-understand product vision that aligns with Hive’s strategic objectives.
  • Oversee the entire product journey and vision, guiding it from inception and validation through development, delivery, operations and continuous iterations.
  • Works closely with stakeholders to ensure that backlog are aligned to business’s values and OKR.
  • Manage and facilitate prioritization discussion with relevant stakeholders on Sprint backlog and Quarterly Backlog
  • Cultivate a culture based on trust, psychological safety & collaborations.
  • Take ownership of the Hive purpose by ensuring each member fully understands and embraces the Hive’s vision & mission
  • Collaborate with the Hive Lead to craft and continually update the Hive’s vision & mission, ensuring they resonate with Hive’s strategic objectives and inspire the Hive.
  • Instil a high-performance culture and true “self-organizing” team by empowering the Squad, celebrate achievements, learning from review/feedback and conducting retrospective for continuous improvement.
  • Coach & mentor fellow PO to continuously uplift PO’s capability and elevating their performance to drive team success.
  • Actively engage in quarterly Hive’s BRP sessions and offer strategic direction in collaboration with Hive Lead.
  • Accountable for ensuring compliance and risk adherence of products and service, engage with stakeholders to ensure necessary controls are adhered to and approvals are obtained.

Product Discovery and Experimentation

  • Champion and integrate a culture of evidence driven decision making
  • Optimize business value of the product or serve by ensuring timely delivery of the right solutions based on customer validated and business viable features and initiatives.
  • Utilize data analytics / feedback to generate idea or identify opportunity of improvement and validate these ideas or opportunities using discovery canvas toolkit or lo-fi prototype.
  • Instil MVP approach or fail-fast concept which allows the Squad to achieve result/output with minimal investment or effort.
  • Lead technical discovery studies to maximize existing investments & where necessary, develop complementary, scalable and cost-efficient technical solutions.
  • Lead and encourage cross-domain learning to enrich product discovery phase.

Product Delivery and Execution

  • Adopt and embed both Change Delivery Standard (CDS) and Group’s Enterprise Software Delivery Lifecycle (eSDLC) throughout the lifecycle of the product or service.
  • Utilize enterprise tools like ADO, to manage sprint and to plan/track backlog items.
  • Owns and defines the DOR to ensure all backlog items are well-prepared for efficient development process and increase the likelihood of delivering high-quality product/service that meet business and customer needs.
  • Owns and defines the DOD to ensures that completed work meets the expected quality standards and is ready for release.
  • Lead and drive the Squad in defining both functional and non-functional requirements for the backlog items, ensuring the products or services meets business and customer need while maintaining high-level of performance reliability, secured and scalable.
  • Adopt a standardized user story writing with Gherkin language for clarity.
  • Monitor core efficiency metrics (ie Speed-to-Production, Say-Do ratio) and identify potential blockers/challenge which could result in delays.
  • Review testing criteria, scenarios and use cases to ensure that products meet Group’s quality standard and business needs.
  • Accountable to provide signoff on shippable product once it has met both DOD (acceptance criteria) and fulfilled testing standards for functionality and performance.
  • Conduct pre-implementation session with stakeholders which include product demo and planning for transition and Go-Live.
  • Perform sprint retrospective and review session with squad to encourage a growth mindset and continuous improvement.
  • Manage a clearly defined, transparent and strategically prioritized backlog for the Hive that aligns with fixed capacity operating model.

Product Analytics

  • Adopt benefit realization mindset by leveraging on metric to maximize value creation.
  • Work with Hive Lead to define and refine Hive’s OKRs, leveraging data-driven insights to ensure that the Group’s objectives are tightly aligned with overarching Business goals.

Key Responsibilities

Are you interested in algorithmic trading? Are you an innovative thinker and enjoy building a business leading platform? We’re looking for someone like that who can:

– Help design and enhance trading algorithms and analytics for the equities business (and beyond)

– Back test trading strategies across different market regimes

– Analyze the way our clients trade to optimize their interactions with UBS

– Provide execution consultancy on client order flow, including the use of Transaction Cost Analysis

– Research market microstructure and produce analysis for clients

– Work closely with Electronic Trading, Equity front office, and IT to deliver regional and global projects

The team

You’ll be working in the Algorithms and Analytics team in London. Our role is to provide trading algorithms and execution consultancy for electronic trading for all equities and other products. Our team is responsible for building top grade, high performance quant trading models, research on market microstructure and helping to optimize the trading performance across equities.

Your Skills And Experience

You have

– At least one relevant internship within a trading, markets, quantitative or closely related environment.

– Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across different teams.

– A proactive, self-driven approach and a strong sense of ownership.

– The ability to learn quickly, adapt to new topics and solve problems independently.

– Good organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

– Strong curiosity and interest in electronic trading, quantitative analysis and technology.

You should

– Programme confidently in Python and/or Java and work effectively with modern IDEs and AI-assisted/agentic coding tools.

– Work comfortably in a Unix/Linux environment and use common development, version-control and DevOps tools.

– Understand basic financial instruments and market structure, with knowledge of futures and/or Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) considered an advantage.

– Apply fundamental concepts in statistics, statistical inference and optimisation to quantitative problems.

– Understand the fundamentals of machine learning and Large Language Models (LLMs), or demonstrate relevant hands-on exposure.

– Past experience of RESTful APIs, microservices and/or agentic systems would be a plus.

– Knowledge of kdb+/q and/or LaTeX would be an advantage.

About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Who we are looking for

Fund Accountant Senior Associate will serve as a subject matter expert and primary reviewer within the team. The role is responsible for overseeing complex operational activities, ensuring quality and control standards are consistently met, and supporting day-to-day delivery across assigned portfolios. The successful candidate will possess strong technical knowledge, sound judgement, and the ability to guide junior team members while maintaining excellent stakeholder relationships.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration and operational support services to alternative investment managers and institutional investors.

The team acts as a key coordination and control point across the alternative investment servicing lifecycle. The team connects client requirements with operational execution, helps ensure that investment, transaction, cash, valuation and reporting information is complete and accurate, and drives timely resolution of exceptions. The role is important in maintaining service quality, strengthening the control environment and supporting scalable, technology-enabled delivery across private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and direct investment structures.

What you will be responsible for

  • Review operational processing completed by Associates and ensure outputs are accurate, complete and compliant with established procedures.
  • Review investment lifecycle transactions, including capital calls, distributions, interest receipts, fees, paydowns and related activities.
  • Validate market values and valuation inputs against supporting documentation, investigate significant movements or discrepancies, and ensure exceptions are appropriately documented, escalated and resolved.
  • Validate supporting documentation and ensure appropriate evidence is maintained.
  • Perform detailed investigation and review of complex reconciliation breaks and exceptions.
  • Execute reviewer controls and ensure maker-checker requirements are properly performed.
  • Identify control weaknesses, operational risks and procedural gaps.
  • Participate in issue investigations, root cause analysis and remediation activities.
  • Support operational incident reporting and corrective action tracking.
  • Act as a key contact for day-to-day operational matters and escalations.
  • Coordinate with custodians, counterparties, administrators and internal support teams to resolve outstanding items.
  • Communicate operational updates and risks to management on a timely basis.

  • Communicate operational updates and risks to management on a timely basis.
  • Provide technical guidance and coaching to Associates.
  • Support onboarding and training of new team members.
  • Share best practices and contribute to knowledge management initiatives.
  • Assist management with workload coordination and delivery monitoring.


What we value

This position provides an opportunity to gain exposure to a broad range of alternative investment products and operational activities, including private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and other complex investment structures. The successful candidate will develop expertise in investment operations, cash management, documentation review and client servicing activities within a global operating environment.

We Value

  • Strong technical and operational expertise.
  • Excellent quality and risk awareness.
  • Sound judgement and decision-making skills.
  • Proactive issue identification and resolution.
  • Strong stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to coach and develop junior staff.
  • Ownership, accountability and professionalism.


Education And Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline.
  • 4-6 years related experience of relevant experience within fund accounting, fund administration, financial services or alternative investment operations.
  • Understanding of alternative investment structures and investment lifecycle events preferred.
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
  • Prior reviewer or checking experience preferred.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify issues, investigate exceptions and escalate appropriately.


Role scope and working relationships

The role is critical in ensuring the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of operational processing and reviewing while supporting a strong control environment and high-quality client service. The role works closely with middle-office and transaction-processing teams, document management, reconciliation, valuation, financial reporting, audit, technology, product and project-management partners. Responsibilities may vary by client, investment type and target operating model.

About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential.
